events.name: Bash
events.head: Show task tool usage and list the starter CRM folder
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py 2>&1 | head -30; ls -la workshop-plan/crm-starter workshop-plan/crm-starter/* | head -80; wc -c workshop-plan/crm-starter/README.md workshop-plan/crm-starter/prompts/* 2>/dev/null; ls scripts/walkthroughs 2>/dev/null | head; ls ~/.config/tantra/ 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the starter CRM README, prompts and core files
events.input: $ cd workshop-plan/crm-starter && for f in README.md .gitignore prompts/*.md crm.py schema.sql; do echo "=========== $f"; cat $f; done; echo; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find guide sources for s5-crm-starter, ledger tail, and key names (no values)
events.input: $ grep -rln "s5-crm-starter" --include=*.py --include=*.json --include=*.md --include=*.ts --include=*.mjs --include=*.html . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -30; tail -40 scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md; ls ~/.config/tantra/keys | head -40; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the earlier T-134 commit, task log and ledger location
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && git show --stat 6c35d7f | head -40; git log --oneline -8 --all --grep="T-134"; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check ledger, reference build, board server, key presence (names and lengths only) and push state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && tail -5 scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-1500; echo ---; ls -la ~/tantra-private/crm-reference ~/tantra-private/crm-reference/captures; echo ---; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "board %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8765/; lsof -nP -iTCP:8765 -sTCP:LISTEN | tail -2; launchctl list | grep -i crm; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents | grep -i crm; echo ---keys; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Re-run the reference build checks and look for the Dodo test key input task
events.input: $ cd ~/tantra-private/crm-reference && cat README-PRIVATE.md; ls crm-starter fixtures follow-ups; cat captures-dry-run.txt | head -40; cd crm-starter; grep -o '^[A-Z_]*' .env 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo; python3 runner.py --dry-run 2>&1 | head -12; python3 crm.py board 2>&1 | head -30; curl -s http://localhost:8765/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*' ; curl -s http://localhost:8765/ | grep -c 'class="card' ; pgrep -fl "board.py|8793" | head; echo ---; grep -oE '^[A-Z0-9_]+' ~/.config/tantra/keys/vendor-test.env | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rl "s5-crm-starter" w

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check the guide for the old capture slots and compare origin with the prompt-fix commit
events.input: $ ls workshop-plan/guides 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -rn "capture-needed\|localhost:8765\|payments.py\|runner.py" $(grep -rl "s5-crm-starter" workshop-plan --include='*.json' --include='*.py' --include='*.ts' -s | grep -v -e tasks/ -e review_hub) 2>/dev/null | grep -i "crm-starter\|8765\|payments.py\|runner.py" | cut -c1-220 | head -20; echo ---; git diff --stat origin/main...6c35d7f -- workshop-plan/crm-starter scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | tail -3; git log --oneline main..origin/main; git diff --stat 6c35d7f^ origin/main -- workshop-plan/crm-starter scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LE

events.name: Bash
events.head: Cherry-pick the prompt-fix commit onto origin/main in a throwaway worktree
events.input: $ W=/tmp/t134-push && rm -rf $W; git worktree add -q --detach $W origin/main && cd $W && git cherry-pick 6c35d7f 2>&1 | tail -4; git status --short | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show the ledger conflict hunk
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t134-push && grep -n '^<<<<<<<\|^=======\|^>>>>>>>' scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md; awk '/^<<<<<<</,/^>>>>>>>/' scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-110

events.name: Bash
events.head: Resolve the ledger conflict keeping both T-134 rows, then push only this commit to origin main
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t134-push && sed -i '' -e '/^<<<<<<< HEAD$/d' -e '/^=======$/d' -e '/^>>>>>>> 6c35d7f/d' scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md && diff <(git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign show main:scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md) scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-120; git add -- scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md && git -c core.editor=true cherry-pick --continue 2>&1 | tail -2; git show --stat HEAD | tail -10; python3 workshop-plan/crm-starter/crm.py --help >/dev/null && echo crm-ok; git push origin HEAD:main 2>&1 | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Remove the temp worktree, update T-134 on the board and acknowledge the note
events.input: $ git worktree remove --force /tmp/t134-push; git fetch -q origin; git diff --stat origin/main main -- workshop-plan/crm-starter | tail -1; V=$(date +%s); curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8765/?v=$V"; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-134 status=review needs_from_owner="" note="The 05:08 'build it' decision was already carried out in the 13:48 pass, so nothing was rebuilt; this pass rechecked it (board on localhost:8765 answers 200 with 10 test deals, runner.py --dry-run lists the next 24h, payments.py recorded the test-mode fixture payment into Payment Comple

events.name: Bash
events.head: Commit the task board update
events.input: $ git add -- workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json && git commit -q -m "Agent T-134: 05:08 decision rechecked as already built, prompt fixes pushed to origin (aafe5d9), task stays in review

events.text: T-134 stays in review: the reference build from the 13:48 pass was rechecked (board up on localhost:8765, dry run works) and the prompt fixes and README are now pushed to origin main (aafe5d9). No real Resend or Dodo test call was made because no test key exists (T-253 already asks for the Dodo one), and nothing went to the mirror because the guide's three capture slots no longer exist. The ack returned "acked 0", so F-7015c234 was probably already acked by the earlier pass.
